newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates ease, end at 19.25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates ease, end at 19.25 pct.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates ended a lower on Friday, the last day of the banks' two-week reserve period, traders said.
Overnight rates opened around 19.75 percent and slipped to a close of 19.25 percent compared with Thursday's close of 19.625 percent.
Traders added that overnight rates were likely to remain below 20.00 percent for the rest of the month.
"I expect the rates to remain below 20.00 percent this month, unless some exceptional event occurs," said Jozsef Laczi of ING Bank.

The National Bank of Hungary's benchmark one-week reverse repo rate stands at 20.00 percent and inter-bank overnight rates remained below it since the beginning of the current reserve period on August 1.
